Alert.description: One served version a malware advisory names.

loaded.description: When byrle first stored the advisory, RFC 3339; absent when the store does not say.

served.description: The served version, as `GET dependencies` lists it.

Alerts.description: Alerts found, and where the next request goes on from.

next.description: `after` for the next request; absent once every served version is looked up.

scanned.description: Served versions looked up for this answer.

CheckAsked.description: What a remote `policy check` sends: the policy, and the command's flags.

environment.description: Each runtime variable, set or not.

oneOf.description: Absent when no policy is set.

Credentials.description: An account and its console password.

DiffAsked.description: What a remote `policy diff` sends: the candidate, the dates, and the versions locked.

from_date.description: `YYYY-MM-DD` or `+<days>d`, for the policy in force.

FailureRow.description: One hour's count of one case in one ecosystem, as `failure_count` holds it.

Failures.description: Failure counts, by hour, ecosystem and case.

Health.description: What the proxy is, and what it is configured to do, without secrets. Served at [`HEALTH_PATH`].

allowed_direct_origins.description: Origins it does not serve and permits a client to fetch directly.

artifacts_revalidated.description: Artifact requests answered 304 since the proxy started, from the client's own cache.

artifacts_verified.description: Artifacts fetched and verified since the proxy started. See [`crate::verified`].

artifacts_with_direct_dependencies.description: Artifact requests for a version that depends on a package by URL, git or path.

clients_without_artifacts.description: The clients the last window found reading documents and fetching no artifact.

decisions_unrecorded.description: Artifact decisions dropped on a full queue or a failed write since the proxy started.

documents_uninspected.description: Metadata documents forwarded without being read or rewritten since the proxy started.

packages_held.description: Packages whose metadata is held, and the records in them.

public_base.description: The address written into artifact URLs; `None` uses each request's own `Host`.

refuse_unservable.description: Whether versions whose artifacts this proxy cannot serve are removed.

rewrite_artifacts.description: Whether artifact URLs are pointed at this proxy.

served_origins.description: Origins whose artifacts this proxy serves.

service.description: Always "byrle", so a response from something else is recognisable as such.

spool_dir.description: Where an artifact being analysed is written, when a spool is open.

tokens_required.description: Whether a request needs a proxy token. See [`crate::account::gate`].

upstreams.description: Each ecosystem's upstream, by purl type.

usage_unrecorded.description: Usage table rows dropped on a full queue or a failed write since the proxy started.

Lines.description: A page of lines, as served.

files_read.description: How many files were read for this page.

lines.description: Each line as the log holds it: docs/engineering_decisions/0087-audit-log.md.

next.description: `after` for the next page; absent on the last.

disabled.description: When it was disabled; its tokens and sessions stopped then.

csrf.description: Sent back as `x-byrle-csrf` on each request with the cookie other than GET or HEAD.

expires.description: When the session ends, RFC 3339, UTC.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the file, as the audit log records it.

Printed.description: What a command printed on the deployment, and the code it exited with.

Problem.description: Why a request was not answered.

Sent.description: One version a lockfile locks, and the repository it names when it names one.

ServedRow.description: A version served to an account, as `served_version` holds it.

id.description: What the next page starts after.

Setting.description: One runtime variable as the console shows it.

default.description: What applies when it is unset, when that is a value.

value.description: As set, a secret as `set` and a URL without its password. Absent when unset.

Up.description: The console's health: `up`, or the worst state and the components not up, by name.

components.description: The components not up; absent when every one is.

next.description: `after` for the next page; absent on the last.

token.description: A proxy token from `byrle token create`, in any form the proxy takes: Bearer, Basic with the token as the password, the token alone, or X-Byrle-Token

info.description: The admin console's API. Each operation that needs a permission names it in `x-byrle-permission`; see docs/admin-plan.md §4.2.
